documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30,2026.
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board M,Eeting Held On November 04,2026

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported a 25% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue for Q1 FY27, driven primarily by a favorable product mix and export growth. The company is expanding its domestic capacity with a new line expected to be operational by March 2027 and is evaluating potential international expansion in regions like Mexico or the U.S. Management anticipates a top-line growth of 10% to 15% over the next three years, supported by increasing wallet share with existing U.S. automotive OEMs. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, highlighting strong growth in revenue, PBT, and PAT driven by export momentum and automotive segment performance.

guidance.claim: The company expects a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next three years.
guidance.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates overall growth between 10% to 15% while expecting modest domestic growth.
guidance.quote: So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth, we are not looking very strong growth in the domestic market.

guidance.claim: The company expects its U.S. business to increase by 60% to 70% over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

guidance.claim: Sales growth and increased momentum are expected to continue for the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8% and 10% and export growth between 15% and 20%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Mayur Uniquoters is targeting double-digit growth with a potential outlook of 15% growth for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have said that we are targeting a 2-digit growth in the coming years. This year also and the coming years. So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is observing very strong growth in the export market.
demand_outlook.quote: But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic footwear market experienced a degrowth in the last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: That is not necessarily true, excepting domestic footwear market where we have had a degrowth in the last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects business from Mahindra to increase in the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: So our business from Mahindra will be increasing in the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The signing of FTAs is expected to increase customer sentiment for procuring from India, particularly in Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the polyurethane (PU) business demand is currently muted.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has secured export orders from the US for OEM supply, contributing positively to revenues and profits.
demand_outlook.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply and resulting into good contribution to our top line and bottom line.

demand_outlook.claim: The marine business is growing rapidly with Europe representing a key market.
demand_outlook.quote: So our Marine business is also growing very fast and Europe is also a great market for it.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic footwear business growth is impacted by local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

demand_outlook.claim: Prices of raw materials like plasticizers and yarn have started moving up.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up. So, I think the price is going up also.

capex_expansion.claim: Production from the new expansion is expected to start between February and March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The new line will provide an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating two additional expansions, including one potentially outside of India.
capex_expansion.quote: So we are looking at two more expansions, but that is not finalized till now. One may be outside India.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex plan for the 2026-2027 financial year is approximately INR 50 crores.
If a new facility is finalized, the company could see a capex of INR 250 crores over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the proposed South plant is estimated at approximately INR 200 crores, while a global scale plant is estimated at INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So if we are evaluating which one we have to go for first. But if we do in South, it's approximately INR200 crores. If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Once decided, the South plant will take about 2 years to start operations with an initial monthly capacity of 500,000 meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start. And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

capex_expansion.claim: Mayur Uniquoters has formed a new subsidiary in Europe to stock products and target regional customers.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have now formed a new company in Europe, and we are exporting from India to Europe, getting stock over there and tackle customers over there also.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects a sustainable margin of 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Shipment costs increased fourfold during the last quarter due to war.
margins_costs.quote: And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in realization was driven by a mix change toward higher-priced export items.
margins_costs.quote: It's a mix because not only raw material prices, it is because our export business has grown, so it's a higher price item.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material availability is currently not an issue and prices have softened slightly from March highs.
margins_costs.quote: So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now. And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 consolidated revenue grew 14% year-on-year, while PBT increased 58% and PAT increased 66%.
margins_costs.quote: In this quarter, the consolidated revenue increased by 14% and PBT and PAT increased by 58% and 66%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects to sustain its current margin levels supported by export growth.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, we should be able to maintain this level of margin.

margins_costs.claim: Imports account for nearly one-third of the total raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Foreign exchange gains accounted for approximately 50% of other income during the quarter, with the balance coming from treasury income.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently utilizing between 75% to 78% of its capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: New OEM supply orders from the U.S.A. have begun contributing to export revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has secured orders from Ford and expects business to increase with Ford and Chrysler.
orders_capacity.quote: So we have got good orders from Ford and the business will increase with Ford also and in Chrysler also.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume sold in the year was 31 million meters, representing a volume growth of approximately 5%.
Volume growth was approximately 5% for the total business.
orders_capacity.quote: Volume growth is a total 4.5%. Nearly 5%.

orders_capacity.claim: Q3 domestic revenues included INR 52.01 crores from Auto OEM, INR 38.84 crores from replacement, and INR 39.93 crores from footwear.
orders_capacity.quote: Auto OEM domestic INR52.01 crores; replacement INR38.84 crores; footwear INR39.93 crores; furnishing INR6.47 crores and others INR2.56 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume sold in Q3 was 76.3 lakh meters, which included 2.56 lakh meters of PU leather.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has contributed to the plantation of 50,000 plants and plans to scale this up in coming years.
capital_allocation.quote: Under the corporate social responsibility programs, we have contributed towards regular plantations around 50,000 plants already done and have a plan to do it at larger scale in coming years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not taken a decision regarding a share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: So for buyback, we have not taken the call.

risks_headwinds.claim: Market volatility is being driven by Trump tariffs and the West Asia war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: The PU segment faces intense competition from China.
risks_headwinds.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disturbances in shipping lines have become very high.
risks_headwinds.quote: Shipping lines disturbance has become very high.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices have been highly volatile since March.
risks_headwinds.quote: So obviously, there was an increase in the raw material prices, which started happening in the month of March. And the market has been very volatile since then.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term impact on domestic business occurs due to the time required to pass on raw material price increases to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cheap imports from China pose a challenge in the market.
risks_headwinds.quote: A lot of cheap imports are coming from China. There's a lot of manipulation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is currently not impacted by import tariffs imposed by Mexico.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are not -- I can just tell you in brief right now, we are not impacted right now.

risks_headwinds.claim: The European automotive industry is experiencing degrowth.
risks_headwinds.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: U.S. business is expected to increase by 60% to 70% in the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

management_commitments.claim: Production from the new expansion line is scheduled to start by February or March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a capex of around INR 50 crores for the current financial year.
If a new facility is finalized, the company will have a capex of 250 crores in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The increased export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The new coating line ordered for the existing location should be completed by the end of the current calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects export order momentum from US OEMs to continue.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an average 15% growth rate for coming years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
